name: mt-transport
description: Node client for the PAC private Meshtastic protocol: chunked payload transfer, message queue, on-demand pull, config and commands. Everything the alarm carries that stock Meshtastic does not.

mtTransport.note: pushProtoVersion MUST match mtchunkpush::PUSH_PROTO_VERSION in mylibs/mt-chunk-push/src/MtChunkPush.h and PROTO_VERSION in lib/chunk-push.js. node-dash loads this module by PATH (MT_TRANSPORT_PATH), not as a versioned dependency, so this field is currently the only way to answer "which client is running?".
